request.style: English, male solo voice with warm choir, cello, piano, harp, timpani, solemn and hopeful, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The hour has come to wake from sleep
Salvation is near now
We cast off the works of darkness
And put on the armor of light

[Chorus]
Clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus
Give no thought to the flesh
The night is nearly over
The day is at hand

[Verse]
Live decently as in the daytime
Not in carousing or drunkenness
No sexual immorality or debauchery
No quarreling or jealousy

[Chorus]
Clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus
Give no thought to the flesh
The night is nearly over
The day is at hand

[Bridge]
We know the time is here
Wake from your sleep tonight
Put on the armor of light
And let the day break

[Chorus]
Clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus
Give no thought to the flesh
The night is nearly over
The day is at hand

[Outro]
Clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus
Give no thought to the flesh
